tools.name: confirm_login
tools.note: NEW ROUTE. The durable token store moves here — it is identity state

tools.name: settings
tools.note: PERSON FACTS ONLY. timezone, and the mail preferences that say how this person wants to be contacted — facts about the PERSON, so identity owns them and flows reads them through the one door every domain may use. The bot DEFAULTS that used to sit in the same file are not person facts: they are this person's defaults for THEIR bot, and the bot is meetings' (see meetings/bot_config). That split shrinks this tool's vocabulary by one key, which is the only user-visible change in the move.

tools.name: start_onboarding
tools.note: An IDENTITY route, and nothing else. It creates the account, mails the code, and publishes `onboarding.completed`. Seeding a desk is a REACTION to that event and exists only where the agent domain is deployed — so the tool has one door in every one of the eight configurations. The version in core/mcp calls admin-api and then agent-api, which is the shape this ruling forbids.

publishes_events.triggers: the desk seed (agent), a welcome flow, and a paid deployment's subscribe prompt
